in_marathi.name: Vishvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vishvansh is a Sanskrit and Hindi name derived from the word 'Vishva' which means 'universe' or 'all pervading'. The name Vishvansh signifies the Lord of the Universe, one who is the creator of the universe and the pervader of all that exists.
